sources.title: A Theory of Shape by Space Carving
sources.findings: A maximal photo-consistent shape contains all consistent shapes under the stated radiance/initial-volume assumptions. Fig4 shows private camera cavities that match images but have wrong scene geometry. Known background segmentation is optional; the gargoyle example does not use it. The practical sweeps use subsets of views; this is not identical to exact full-visibility GVC.

sources.title: Generalized Voxel Coloring
sources.findings: Shared opaque voxel model, item buffers identify closest voxel per pixel, LDI updates visibility after carving. Check color only at currently visible pixels. Monotonic consistency is required for the conservative-carving argument; the authors empirical standard-deviation test is explicitly nonmonotonic. Exact visibility means visibility in the hypothesized voxel model, not ground-truth visibility.

candidate_outline_not_frozen_protocol.inputs: Per-eye causal current/past actual RGB, recorded K and encoder/IMU camera transforms; CAD only under its inherited scope. No GT silhouettes, object families, background RGB, render pose or depth.
candidate_outline_not_frozen_protocol.metric_scale: Existing native metric camera translations/K. No new sensor or metric reference created.
candidate_outline_not_frozen_protocol.RGB_falsification: For a surface voxel visible in two or more distinct causal cameras under a conservative common superset, incompatible observed colors can reject that voxel under an explicit radiance/noise model. Removing it changes visibility and requires reevaluation of newly exposed voxels. A voxel visible only in one camera or hidden does not provide multi-view exclusion.
candidate_outline_not_frozen_protocol.visibility: Render the shared remaining volume to item buffers or LDIs for only cameras already available. Must account for potential occluders along all tested camera-to-voxel segments; a .5m output lower limit does not certify nearer space empty.
candidate_outline_not_frozen_protocol.background: No black or known far-background color is needed for this color-comparison mechanism; background absence alone is NOT a reason to reject it. Cropped local volumes must not invent unoccluded sightlines across omitted possible foreground occluders.
candidate_outline_not_frozen_protocol.outputs: A photo-consistent possible-geometry outer volume/visibility history. Its first hit is not by itself a certified true obstacle surface, and a hull boundary is not automatically both bounds of a true first-surface interval.
candidate_outline_not_frozen_protocol.implementation_location_if_contract_exis: A separate causal voxel-set visibility/carving adapter using existing sanitized RGB/native pose loader and v96 projection interface; neither old density field nor per-pixel cost consumer is reused as qualified depth.
candidate_outline_not_frozen_protocol.coverage_gaps: Private-view shells, low/repeated texture, lack of multi-view visibility/parallax, shadows/view dependence, finite voxel/pixel footprint and native-pose error can leave ambiguity or wrongly reject a surface. Suspended/contact-invisible/boundary targets remain in the original full denominators. No E0 coverage has been computed for these papers.
candidate_outline_not_frozen_protocol.necessary_stops: No depth fit/source run until initial scene-domain/exclusion assumptions, causal visibility, finite surface interval extraction and radiance/pose robustness have an online-available falsifiable contract. Missing/occluded/inconsistent never becomes observed free or clears risk. Complete original source/per-frame gates remain unchanged.

direct_history_comparison.positive_cone: Old positive masks and baseline support yield possible volume without RGB radiance checks or shared current occluder updates; not identical to GVC.
direct_history_comparison.plane_sweep: Old per-query inverse-depth ZNCC median/winner and confidence interval has depth-dependent view validity but no globally shared opaque-voxel visibility state; full visibility is a structural change, not a descriptor substitution. Its historical scores are not current four-camera performance.
direct_history_comparison.radiance_grid: Old RGB/density emission-absorption mixtures can match color by combining locations. Hard opaque-voxel consistency removes that mixing but does not eliminate all photo-consistent geometry ambiguity.
direct_history_comparison.old_footprint: Read provenance_grid/provenance_policy only: privileged depth+true-pose diagnostic; seed_body only sets a 2D geometry mask and does not feed floor labels. Its pose_sigma=0 is explicitly privileged, not a usable native 3D free-space error contract.
direct_history_comparison.scope: Focused source comparison only; not an exhaustive claim no previous implementation exists.

actual_input_schema_check.limitation: This schema absence does not prove no usable bound can be derived elsewhere. No empirical pose error statistic was promoted to an online hard bound; no depth/image arrays or GT target scores were generated.

evidence.GravityRolling.update: Integrates previous velocity and gyro; optional acceleration normalization gravity correction at gain1 when abs(norm(acc)-9.81)<=.5; shellomega=R@(gyro+[0,encoder,0]); velocity=radius*cross(shellomega,normal). No slip-state estimate, uncertainty propagation, bias bound or error output.
evidence.interval_packet: qualified validates finite data, is_valid and .02s timestamp interval alignment. It is NOT a position/slip accuracy certificate.
evidence.collector: Uses privileged initial R0/p0 and flat z=.4000000059604645, then maps estimated rolling pose to world. This is a point estimate, not an enclosing pose set. Initial world gauge alone is not a reason local relative geometry is invalid; relative drift remains relevant.
evidence.old_footprint: ProvenanceGrid.seed_body makes a 2D radius.4 mask only, does not update floor/hazard labels. pose_sigma=0 is expressly privileged depth/true-pose diagnostic. ExplorationGrid permits controlled unknown traversal and does not certify it free.
evidence.body_geometry: Rolling radius constant is NOT by itself evidence of an obstacle-excluding solid ball of that radius or a closed collision envelope. No CAD asset changed/expanded; no watertight/inscribed-solid certificate established in this bounded reading.
evidence.missing_contract: No conservative bounds on slip/integration/sensor/mount error are supplied by the inspected direct producer chain. This is not an exhaustive absence proof for every file, nor proof that RGB/IMU/encoder cannot estimate pose.

conditional_geometry_contract_not_implem.notation: Let S_t be a certified robot interior/occupied solid in body coordinates, and E_t an online set guaranteed to contain the true relative pose. For static external obstacles and valid noninterpenetration, F_t = intersection_{T in E_t} T(S_t) is an obstacle-excluded core at time t. Union of these cores over past t is swept exclusion. Merely unioning point-estimate transforms has no conservative guarantee.
conditional_geometry_contract_not_implem.erosion: A sufficient erosion for a bounded solid with max body radius R is eps_position + 2*R*sin(eps_angle/2) for eps_angle in [0,pi], plus solid/mount/discretization uncertainty; to exclude a whole cubic voxel, include its half diagonal. For an exactly rotationally invariant certified sphere rotation has no effect; do not invent an angular penalty for it.
conditional_geometry_contract_not_implem.current_reference: A global rigid initial gauge cancels in relative coordinates; old-to-current relative error does not. Current known CAD can exclude its own physical geometry only under its calibration/solid contract; it is not a past world-space free tube.
conditional_geometry_contract_not_implem.temporal_scope: Requires static obstacles over the use interval; prior robot occupancy does not certify current freedom after dynamic objects enter. Absence of contact labels offline is not an online swept-volume accuracy observation.
conditional_geometry_contract_not_implem.limits: No eroded tube calculated, voxel removed, posterior variance estimated or surface interval generated. No empirical GT P90 used as a hard bound. This is a conditional mathematical explanation, not a certified deployed algorithm.

swept_exclusion_followup.decision: STOP_CURRENT_VISIBILITY_CARVING_SWEPT_EXCLUSION_ADAPTATION_BEFORE_IMPLEMENTATION. The direct estimator and old footprint do not supply its necessary conservative 3D exclusion contract. Not a measured failure of SpaceCarving/GVC or proof all current sensors fail.

protocol.question: Can existing per-eye causal estimated camera matrices be naively stacked as the parallel-camera-plane view input assumed by the two papers? This is a finite input-adapter check, not a test of all possible ray-space resampling.
protocol.inputs: All110 saved frame containers; only source_time_s and four *_camera_usd_world_estimated matrices. Past/current same eye within10seconds, no future. No RGB/depth/render-label arrays read.
protocol.computation: For each eye/window >=3views, report count, centre spread, maximum axial centre displacement relative to current optical axis, and best-centre-plane SVD residual when>=4views. Axial displacement !=0 demonstrates that rotation-only normalization plus naive view stacking does not meet a fixed common camera plane perpendicular to current axis. A fitted plane alone is not a full EPI sampling certificate.
protocol.interpretation: No tuned gate, no source performance/coverage score, no new depth hypothesis. Zero current-axis displacement and small plane residual would still require measured angular sampling/visibility and resampling qualification; nonzero does not rule out generalized light fields or other planes.

mechanisms_examined: EPI structure-tensor slope with joint visibility labeling

primary_sources.title: Globally Consistent Depth Labeling of4DLight Fields
primary_sources.findings: Two-plane light-field parameterization: EPI line slope links image displacement to camera-plane displacement through -f/Z. Dense angular sampling enables structure-tensor slope estimates; global labeling enforces cross-view visibility. Single moving camera gantry is allowed for static scenes, so special light-field hardware is not categorically required.

primary_sources.title: A Fourier Disparity Layer Representation for Light Fields
primary_sources.findings: Per-frequency linear regression decomposes sub-aperture images into additive disparity layers; layer pixels need not be nonnegative. Derivation uses nonoccluded Lambertian discrete-disparity regions; authors note transparent-looking occlusion artifacts. View synthesis works without a per-pixel disparity map; this does not yield a trustworthy first-surface map by itself.

primary_source_inquiry.online_scale: Existing K and metric encoder/IMU camera displacement can set scale if ray-space sampling/rectification is established. Merely calling historical RGB a light field adds no new metric reference.
primary_source_inquiry.RGB_falsification: EPI line coherence can reject slopes that do not follow observed spatio-angular structures; a joint labeling adds visibility relationships. Uniform/repeated texture, unresolved multiple slopes, sparse angular sampling and occlusions can remain ambiguous. FDL image fit alone does not identify a unique first opaque surface.
primary_source_inquiry.direct_old_comparison: Old lk_surface_v1/protocol_v2 tracks sparse current-to-past points then triangulates, with no full EPI labeling; v99 positive density/transmittance color mixture differs from FDL signed additive Fourier layers. These are structural representation/constraint differences, not a claim these papers have passed novelty/source gates. A slope-only replacement for LK would still reuse temporal parallax and cannot be advertised as a new independent metric observation.
primary_source_inquiry.implementation_if_admitted: A separate GT-free causal ray-space sampling adapter and full-view visibility/depth labeling, followed by existing v96 BEV consumer. Not implemented. No new weights/dependencies.
primary_source_inquiry.input_and_surface_contract_unresolved: Naively stacking views after orientation correction assumes a common camera plane. Arbitrary calibrated rays can in principle be reparameterized; generating sufficiently sampled EPI slices from the current causal path without using unknown depth has not been established. Regularity/coverage were not measured because the metadata probe did not execute. FDL layer energies/signs are not probabilities or a first-surface depth distribution.
primary_source_inquiry.full_domain_requirement: All110groups/440eyes and original11652target-cell instances including2535suspended would remain in any source gate. No current-domain depth, coverage, latency, RGB false-positive or navigation result exists for these adaptations.
primary_source_inquiry.decision: No executable source contract frozen; no slope-threshold, Fourier-layer or per-frame model fit. This is incomplete input-adapter qualification with a failed diagnostic, not a measured EPI/FDL performance failure or proof all light-field adaptations impossible.
